articles.body: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and costs 4.99 dollars. Shipping is free on orders over 50 dollars. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 14.99 dollars. We ship to addresses in the United States and Canada. Orders placed before 2 pm Central Time ship the same business day. You will get a tracking email as soon as your order leaves our warehouse.
articles.title: Shipping times and costs

articles.body: You can track your order from the link in your shipping confirmation email. You can also sign in to your NorthPeak account and open Order History to see live tracking. Tracking usually appears within 24 hours of placing the order. If tracking shows no movement for 3 business days, contact support and we will check with the carrier.
articles.title: Tracking your order

articles.body: You can return any NorthPeak product within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in their original condition with all accessories included. Return shipping is free: we email you a prepaid return label after you start the return. Refunds go back to your original payment method unless you choose store credit. Items bought on final sale cannot be returned.
articles.title: Returns policy

articles.body: We process your refund within 2 business days of receiving your return. After processing, the money reaches your account in 5 to 7 business days, depending on your bank. Refunds to the original payment method are automatic. Store credit refunds arrive by email within 1 business day of processing. You will get an email at each step: when your return arrives, when the refund is processed, and when it is sent.
articles.title: Refunds: timing and methods

articles.body: Every NorthPeak device includes a 2 year limited warranty from the date of delivery. The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship, including battery failure in normal use. It does not cover accidental damage, water damage, or damage from unauthorized repairs. If a covered device fails, we repair it, replace it, or refund it at our choice. Keep your order confirmation email as proof of purchase for warranty claims.
articles.title: Warranty coverage

articles.body: To file a warranty claim, sign in to your NorthPeak account, open Order History, and choose File a Warranty Claim on the device. Describe the problem and add a photo if the damage is visible. We reply within 1 business day with next steps. Most claims are approved within 2 business days. If we ask you to send the device in, we email a prepaid shipping label.
articles.title: How to file a warranty claim

articles.body: Plug the NorthPeak Hub into power and connect it to your router with the included ethernet cable. Open the NorthPeak app and tap Add Device, then choose Hub. The hub light turns solid blue when it is ready, usually within 2 minutes. The hub must stay connected to your router for your other devices to work. Place the hub in a central spot, away from metal shelves and microwaves.
articles.title: Setting up your NorthPeak Hub

articles.body: NorthPeak devices connect to 2.4 GHz WiFi networks only. They do not support 5 GHz only networks or enterprise WPA networks. To connect, open the NorthPeak app, tap Add Device, and follow the steps to enter your WiFi password. Keep the device within 30 feet of your router during setup. WiFi passwords are case sensitive, so type yours exactly as it appears on your router.
articles.title: Connecting a device to WiFi

articles.body: If a device will not connect, first check that it is powered on and its status light is blinking blue, which means it is ready to pair. Make sure you are joining a 2.4 GHz network, because NorthPeak devices do not support 5 GHz only networks. Restart the device by unplugging it for 10 seconds. Restart your router by unplugging it for 30 seconds. Move the device closer to the router and try setup again. If it still fails, reset the device and repeat setup from the start.
articles.title: Device will not connect to WiFi

articles.body: The NorthPeak doorbell camera battery lasts up to 6 months on a full charge with typical use. Heavy motion traffic can shorten battery life. To charge it, slide the doorbell off its mount and plug in the included USB-C cable. A full charge takes about 5 hours, and the app shows the battery level at all times. The doorbell also works wired to existing doorbell wires, which keeps the battery topped up.
articles.title: Doorbell camera battery and charging

articles.body: Before installing the NorthPeak thermostat, turn off power to your heating and cooling system at the breaker. The thermostat works with most 24 volt systems, including gas, electric, and heat pump systems without a C wire when you use the included power adapter. Take a photo of your old thermostat wiring before you remove it. Installation takes about 30 minutes with the step by step guide in the app. Turn the power back on only after the thermostat clicks firmly onto its wall plate.
articles.title: Thermostat installation basics

articles.body: To pair a device, open the NorthPeak app and tap the plus button, then Add Device. Put the device in pairing mode: its status light blinks blue when it is ready. The app finds nearby devices over Bluetooth, then connects them to your WiFi. Pairing takes about 2 minutes. If the app cannot find the device, move your phone within 10 feet of it and try again. Each device can live in only one NorthPeak home at a time.
articles.title: Pairing a device in the NorthPeak app

articles.body: Create a NorthPeak account with your email address in the app or on our website. If you forget your password, tap Forgot Password on the sign in screen and we will email you a reset link that works for 1 hour. You can turn on two step verification under Account Security in the app. If you change your email address, your devices and order history move with the account automatically.
articles.title: Your account: sign in and password help

articles.body: NorthPeak Protect is an optional plan that adds 30 days of video history and smart alerts for 4.99 dollars per month per home. We bill the payment method on your account on the same day each month. You can cancel Protect at any time in the app under Account, then Subscriptions, and you keep the features until the end of the paid month. Without Protect, cameras still record motion clips for 24 hours at no cost.
articles.title: NorthPeak Protect plan and billing

articles.body: To change the card we bill, open the app, go to Account, then Payment Methods, and add the new card before removing the old one. We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. If a payment fails, we email you and retry in 3 days. Your Protect plan pauses only after two failed retries. Updating your card in Payment Methods updates it for future orders and subscriptions at the same time.
articles.title: Changing your payment method

articles.body: NorthPeak never sells your personal data. Camera video is encrypted in transit and at rest, and only people you invite to your home in the app can view it. Motion clips without a Protect plan are deleted after 24 hours. You can download or delete your data at any time under Account, then Privacy in the app. Deleting your account removes your data within 30 days.
articles.title: Privacy and your data

articles.body: A factory reset removes a device from your account and erases its WiFi settings. To reset most NorthPeak devices, press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds until the status light flashes orange. After a reset you must set the device up again in the app as if it were new. Reset does not cancel subscriptions or delete video history stored in your account.
articles.title: Factory reset a device

articles.body: NorthPeak devices update their firmware automatically overnight when they are connected to WiFi. You can check for an update manually in the app under the device settings, then Firmware. Updates take about 5 minutes and the device restarts once. Do not unplug a device while it is updating. We recommend keeping automatic updates on so your devices get security fixes as soon as they are ready.
articles.title: Firmware updates

articles.body: NorthPeak support is available Monday to Friday, 8 am to 8 pm Central Time. You can reach us by chat in the app, by email at support@northpeakhome.example, or by phone at 1-800-555-0142. These are demonstration contact details for this sample setup. For safety issues, such as a device that is hot to the touch or smoking, unplug it and call us right away.
articles.title: Contacting NorthPeak support
